dslRule:
<!id: jfacedoc.singleToMultiLineRule>
<!description: Replace SingleLineRule with MultiLineRule for Javadoc link tags to support multi-line highlighting.>
<!severity: HINT>

new org.eclipse.jface.text.rules.SingleLineRule($start, $end, $token) :: matchesAny($start, "{@link", "{@value", "{@inheritDoc")
=> new org.eclipse.jface.text.rules.MultiLineRule($start, $end, $token)
;;
summary: Replace `SingleLineRule` with `MultiLineRule` for Javadoc link tags to enable multi-line syntax highlighting, ensuring correct rendering of Javadoc comments that span multiple lines.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
